First, evaluate the user's requested topic: '{{3.`2`}}'.

Advanced Track – AI agents, RAG systems, multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, complex API integrations, advanced automation architecture, or advanced AI automation concepts.

Practical Track – Make.com, n8n, Zapier, webhooks, REST APIs, CRM automation, email automation, chatbot implementation, workflow automation, or business process automation.

Foundational Track – Introduction to AI automation, basic automation concepts, workflow fundamentals, automation terminology, or general business automation concepts.
